days.title: High Alpine Peaks and Nature Parks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hintertux Glacier
stops.detail: The Hintertux Glacier forms the crowning glory at the end of the valley.

stops.name: Zillertal Alps High Mountain Nature Park
stops.detail: The greatest scenic sensation is the Zillertal Alps High Mountain Nature Park, its 80 glaciers and the numerous three-thousand metre peaks with the Hochfeiler (3,509 metres) as the highest elevation.

stops.name: Hintertux Glacier Nature Ice Palace
stops.detail: In addition to the numerous sporting activities, the Hintertux Glacier Nature Ice Palace is also an exciting attraction.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Zemmtal valley
stops.detail: Only from Mayrhofen, where the Zillertal splits into the narrow Zemmtal valley with the mountaineering village of Ginzling and the Tuxertal valley, does it begin to rise sharply.

stops.name: Zillertal Railway
stops.detail: The Zillertal Railway, a modern means of transport that is still partly operated by nostalgic steam locomotives, fits in with this in a way.

stops.name: Arena Coaster
stops.detail: The Arena Coaster summer toboggan run is ideal for children (but adults will also get their money's worth here - we promise!).

stops.name: Beer Adventure World
stops.detail: For beer drinkers, the Beer Adventure World is an absolute must.

stops.name: Mayrhofen adventure pool
stops.detail: For bad weather days, we recommend the beer adventure world for the grown-ups or the Mayrhofen adventure pool or the Erlebnistherme Zillertal for the family.
